title: Keep incompatible published parameter certificates and direct-smoothing TV failure explicit
statement: In the stated Gaussian-cloud certificate theta_n=Ccl*Lmath^(9/2)*eta_n*h^4*sqrt(d+Lmath), with required theta_n<=eta_n/8 and Lmath=Theta(log d). For h=exp(-aL^(1/3)),L=log(d+2), log(theta_n/eta_n)=.5L-4aL^(1/3)+4.5log L+O(1)->infinity. Increasing ideal Picard depth alone therefore cannot transplant this existing cloud design. The ideal quadrature certificate with J~L^(2/3) needs eta on an exp(-O(L^(1/3))) scale, whereas the available RGO UPPER bound O(Lmath^(21/4)*[eta^2(d+Lmath)]^(1/4)) only certifies sharp-scale cost with eta<=d^-1/2*exp(O(L^(1/3))). These existing guarantees do not compose at the desired scale; this is not an intrinsic RGO lower bound. Also, for V=||x||^2/2, original N(0,I) and smoothed N(0,(1+eta)I) have affinity[2sqrt(1+eta)/(2+eta)]^(d/2). If d*eta^2->infinity, affinity->0 and TV->1. A terminal unsmoothing correction is essential; no arbitrary-algorithm negative follows.
